home.who-we-are.text2.label: Paragraph
home.who-we-are.text2.default: Mekotex's textile business dates back to 1971, and the company was established in 1991. The site on the Main National Highway in Landhi, Karachi, brings every stage of production together, from raw cotton to packed export cartons.

home.who-we-are.text3.label: Paragraph

about.page-header.heading1.label: Heading
about.page-header.heading1.default: Five decades of textile craft in Karachi.

about.our-story.text2.label: Paragraph
about.our-story.text2.default: Mekotex (Pvt.) Limited is a Karachi-based, vertically integrated textile manufacturer and exporter specialising in home textiles, denim, fabrics and digital printing. Its textile business began in 1971, and Mekotex was established as a company in 1991.

about.our-story.text3.label: Paragraph
about.our-story.text3.default: Today Mekotex runs integrated manufacturing from ginning and spinning to stitching and packing, and supplies bedding, denim, fabrics and kitchen, window and bath textiles to buyers abroad.

about.our-site.text2.label: Paragraph
about.our-site.text2.default: Long-span production sheds, a finished-goods warehouse, utilities and rooftop solar sit together on one secured campus with direct access to the Main National Highway and onward routes to Karachi's ports.

about.our-site.text3.label: Paragraph
about.our-site.text3.default: Every vehicle and visitor enters through a controlled security gate, and internal roads link the receiving, production and dispatch areas.

about.our-people.text2.label: Paragraph
about.our-people.text2.default: Operators, technicians, inspectors and merchandisers run every stage of production, from the stitching lines to final checking and packing.

about.at-a-glance.heading1.label: Heading
about.at-a-glance.heading1.default: From the gate to the warehouse.

history.page-header.heading1.label: Heading
history.page-header.heading1.default: A family of textile businesses since 1971.

history.content.text1.label: Paragraph
history.content.text1.default: From its first textile operations in 1971 to the founding of Mekotex (Pvt.) Limited in 1991, the business has grown into an integrated manufacturer serving international home-textile programmes.

history.textile-operations-begin.text1.label: Paragraph
history.textile-operations-begin.text1.default: The group's textile business starts in Karachi, building the experience in fibre, yarn and fabric that Mekotex is founded on.

history.textile-operations-begin.text2.label: Paragraph
history.textile-operations-begin.text2.default: Mekotex is incorporated as a private limited company in Karachi, Pakistan, focused on textile manufacturing and export.

history.textile-operations-begin.text3.label: Paragraph
history.textile-operations-begin.text3.default: Capabilities are brought under one organisation: ginning, spinning, weaving, denim, dyeing, processing, digital printing, finishing, cutting, stitching and packing.

history.textile-operations-begin.text4.label: Paragraph
history.textile-operations-begin.text4.default: The company works to management-system, product and sourcing standards including ISO 14001, OEKO-TEX® STeP and Made in Green, GOTS, Better Cotton and Textile Exchange standards.

history.textile-operations-begin.text5.label: Paragraph
history.textile-operations-begin.text5.default: A secured campus at 495-DEH Main National Highway, Landhi, with stitching halls, a finished-goods warehouse, utilities and rooftop solar generation.

history.textile-operations-begin.text6.label: Paragraph
history.textile-operations-begin.text6.default: Dated milestones are those confirmed by Mekotex. Further dates can be added when the company provides them.

history.heritage.heading1.label: Heading
history.heritage.heading1.default: The same name on the gate for over three decades.

history.heritage.text2.label: Paragraph
history.heritage.text2.default: The Mekotex mark, a stylised M of parallel lines, stands at the main gate of the Landhi campus beside the company's registered address.

ceo.page-header.heading1.label: Heading
ceo.page-header.heading1.default: A message from our Chief Executive.

vision.how-we-work.text2.default: Eleven manufacturing stages under one organisation give buyers control of quality, lead time and traceability.

vision.how-we-work.text3.label: Paragraph
vision.how-we-work.text3.default: Every piece is inspected on dedicated checking tables before it is packed for export.

vision.how-we-work.text4.label: Paragraph

vision.how-we-work.text5.label: Paragraph

capabilities.content.text1.label: Paragraph
capabilities.content.text1.default: With ginning through to packing under one organisation, Mekotex controls quality, lead time and traceability at every step of a programme.

caps.ginning.d.label: Description
caps.ginning.d.default: Seed cotton is cleaned and the lint is separated from the seed, then pressed into bales. This is the first point of control over fibre quality.

caps.spinning.d.label: Description
caps.spinning.d.default: Opening, carding, drawing and ring spinning turn blended cotton into yarn of consistent count and strength.

caps.weaving.d.label: Description
caps.weaving.d.default: Warp and weft interlace on the looms to produce greige fabrics in the constructions each programme needs.

caps.denim.d.label: Description
caps.denim.d.default: Indigo-dyed warp is woven into twill denim fabrics.

caps.printing.d.label: Description
caps.printing.d.default: Designs are printed directly onto prepared fabric. This suits short runs, sampling and many colourways without screens.

caps.dyeing.d.label: Description
caps.dyeing.d.default: Fabric is dyed to approved shades under controlled temperature and chemistry.

caps.processing.d.label: Description
caps.processing.d.default: Pre-treatment by singeing, desizing, scouring and bleaching prepares greige fabric for even dyeing and printing.

caps.finishing.d.label: Description
caps.finishing.d.default: Stentering and calendering set width, stability, surface and handle to the agreed specification.

caps.cutting.d.label: Description
caps.cutting.d.default: Fabric is spread on long cutting tables and cut into components, which are bundled and tracked to the stitching lines.

caps.stitching.d.label: Description
caps.stitching.d.default: Numbered stitching lines with an overhead hanger system move work between sewing stations, with live output displays on the line.

caps.packing.d.label: Description
caps.packing.d.default: After checking, sets are folded with inserts, bagged and packed into export cartons to the buyer’s instructions.

caps.qc.d.label: Description
caps.qc.d.default: Every piece is checked on dedicated inspection tables. Pieces that need correction go to ALTER bins and back to the line before approved goods move to packing.

caps.warehouse.d.label: Description
caps.warehouse.d.default: Packed export cartons are staged on pallets by order in the finished-goods warehouse, ready for dispatch by road to Karachi's ports.

products.bedding.d.label: Description
products.bedding.d.default: Sheets, duvet covers, pillowcases and bedding sets in plain, dyed and printed qualities, made up and packed in-house.

products.denim.d.label: Description
products.denim.d.default: Denim fabrics produced from indigo-dyed warp for apparel and home programmes.

products.fabrics.d.label: Description
products.fabrics.d.default: Greige, dyed and printed woven fabrics supplied by the metre for converters and brands.

products.kitchen.d.label: Description
products.kitchen.d.default: Kitchen textiles in woven, dyed and printed qualities.

products.window.d.label: Description
products.window.d.default: Window textiles made from in-house woven and finished fabrics.

products.bath.d.label: Description
products.bath.d.default: Bath textile programmes supplied alongside bedding and home collections.

sus.solar.d.label: Solar energy – description
sus.solar.d.default: Rooftop photovoltaic arrays generate electricity across the site’s production roofs.

sus.etp.d.label: Effluent Treatment Plant – description
sus.etp.d.default: Process water is treated before discharge to reduce its environmental impact.

sus.ro.d.label: Reverse Osmosis plant – description
sus.ro.d.default: RO treatment produces high-purity process water and supports water reuse.

sus.water.d.label: Water conservation – description
sus.water.d.default: Water use is managed and reduced across wet processing.

sus.ozone.d.label: Ozone wash technology – description
sus.ozone.d.default: Ozone-based washing can reduce water, chemical and energy use compared with conventional washes.

sus.energy.d.label: Energy & heat recovery – description
sus.energy.d.default: Heat recovery systems and energy conservation programmes cut thermal and electrical demand.

certs.iso14001.d.label: Description
certs.iso14001.d.default: An international standard for environmental management systems. It covers how an organisation identifies and controls its environmental impacts and improves performance.

certs.step.d.label: Description
certs.step.d.default: Certification of production facilities for environmentally friendly processes, occupational health and safety, and socially responsible working conditions.

certs.gots.d.label: Description
certs.gots.d.default: A processing standard for textiles made from organic fibres, with environmental and social criteria along the supply chain.
